--- script properties and handlers order
script s
    property a : 1
    on f()
        return a
    end f
    property b : 2
    on g()
        return b + f()
    end g
end script

on t()
    return s's g()
end t
--- script using outer handler and property
property base : 10

on helper(x)
    return x + base
end helper

script worker
    property factor : 2
    on work(x)
        return (my helper(x)) * factor
    end work
    on direct(x)
        return helper(x)
    end direct
end script

on t()
    return {worker's work(1), worker's direct(2)}
end t
--- script with its and my
script s
    property n : 1
    on f()
        return {n, my n, its n, n of me, n of it}
    end f
    on g(n)
        return {n, my n}
    end g
end script
--- script object returned from handler with closure-like property
on makeAdder(k)
    script adder
        property amount : k
        on add(x)
            return x + amount
        end add
    end script
    return adder
end makeAdder

on t()
    set add5 to makeAdder(5)
    return add5's add(1)
end t
--- script in list and record
script a
    property v : 1
end script

script b
    property v : 2
end script

on t()
    set l to {a, b}
    set r to {first_:a, second_:b}
    return {v of item 1 of l, v of second_ of r, (item 2 of l)'s v}
end t
--- script parent chain
script grand
    property kind : "grand"
    on who()
        return kind
    end who
end script

script parent_
    property parent : grand
    on who()
        return "parent of " & (continue who())
    end who
end script

script child
    property parent : parent_
    on who()
        return "child of " & (continue who())
    end who
end script

on t()
    return child's who()
end t
--- script with run handler and properties
script task
    property done : false
    property result_ : missing value
    on run
        set result_ to 42
        set done to true
        return result_
    end run
end script

on t()
    set r to run task
    return {r, done of task, result_ of task}
end t
--- script handlers with labeled parameters
script s
    on carry from a to b
        return {a, b}
    end carry
    on check of x given strict:f
        return {x, f}
    end check
end script

on t()
    tell s
        set a to carry from 1 to 2
        set b to check of 3 with strict
    end tell
    return {a, b}
end t
--- tell script object blocks
script s
    property n : 0
    on bump()
        set n to n + 1
    end bump
end script

on t()
    tell s
        bump()
        bump()
        set its n to (its n) * 2
        set m to its n
    end tell
    tell s to bump()
    return {m, s's n, n of s}
end t
--- globals between handlers
global counter, names

on setup()
    set counter to 0
    set names to {}
end setup

on add(n)
    set counter to counter + 1
    set end of names to n
end add

on run
    setup()
    add("a")
    add("b")
    return {counter, names}
end run
--- global declared in handlers only
on setup()
    global shared
    set shared to 1
end setup

on use_()
    global shared
    return shared + 1
end use_

on run
    setup()
    return use_()
end run
--- local in run handler
on run
    local a, b
    set a to 1
    set b to a + 1
    set c to b + 1
    return {a, b, c}
end run
--- properties referencing each other
property a : 2
property b : a * 2
property c : {a, b}
property d : "x" & a
property e : a > 1

return {a, b, c, d, e}
--- property with script value and handler value
on helper()
    return 1
end helper

script inner
    property v : 5
end script

property s : inner
property h : helper

on t()
    return {v of s, h}
end t
--- nested handlers access
script outer
    property x : 1
    script inner
        property y : 2
        on both()
            return {x, y, my y, x of outer}
        end both
    end script
    on run
        return inner's both()
    end run
end script
--- script object defined in handler with handlers and nested script
on build()
    script top
        property items_ : {}
        script helper
            on double(n)
                return n * 2
            end double
        end script
        on add(n)
            set end of items_ to helper's double(n)
            return count of items_
        end add
    end script
    return top
end build
--- script object in handler with blank lines
on build(start)
    script counter
        property n : start

        on bump()
            set n to n + 1
            return n
        end bump

        on reset()
            set n to start
        end reset
    end script
    return counter
end build
--- me and current application in script
script s
    on f()
        return {me, it, class of me, name of current application, my class}
    end f
end script
--- property parent application
script finderScript
    property parent : application "Finder"
    on desktopCount()
        return count of items of desktop
    end desktopCount
end script
--- top level script objects and run
script a
    on go()
        return 1
    end go
end script

script b
    on go()
        return a's go() + 1
    end go
end script

return b's go()
--- handlers with same parameter names as properties
property name_ : "p"
property x : 1

on f(x)
    return x
end f

on g(name_)
    return name_ & my name_
end g

on h()
    return {x, name_}
end h
--- recursion in script object
script math
    on fib(n)
        if n < 2 then return n
        return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
    end fib
    on fact(n)
        if n ≤ 1 then return 1
        return n * (my fact(n - 1))
    end fact
end script
--- copy and identity of script objects
script proto
    property items_ : {}
end script

on t()
    copy proto to a
    copy proto to b
    set end of a's items_ to 1
    set c to a
    set end of c's items_ to 2
    return {a's items_, b's items_, proto's items_, a is c, a = proto}
end t
--- global outside used in script object
global g

script s
    on f()
        return g
    end f
end script

set g to 1
return s's f()
--- global outside and declared again in script object
global g, h

script s
    on f()
        global g
        return g
    end f
    on k()
        set h to 2
        return h
    end k
end script

on run
    set g to 1
    return s's f() + s's k()
end run
--- global outside with nested script objects
global g

script outer
    script inner
        on f()
            return g
        end f
    end script
    on run
        return inner's f()
    end run
end script

set g to 1
return run outer
--- global inside a script object for its script objects
script outer
    global g
    script inner
        on f()
            return g
        end f
    end script
    on run
        set g to 3
        return inner's f()
    end run
end script

return run outer
--- global outside not used by script objects
global g, unused

script s
    on f()
        return 1
    end f
end script

on helper()
    return g
end helper

set g to 1
return helper()
--- property and global used in script object
property p : 1
global g

script s
    on f()
        return p + g
    end f
    on k()
        global z
        set z to 1
        return z
    end k
end script

set g to 2
return s's f()
--- script object made in a tell block
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        script s
            on f()
                return name of Finder window 1
            end f
        end script
    end tell
    return s
end t
--- script object made in a tell block at the top level
tell application "Finder"
    script s
        on f()
            return 1
        end f
    end script
end tell
return s
--- script objects made in blocks at the top level
set x to 1
if x = 1 then
    script s
        on f()
            return 1
        end f
    end script
    set y to s
end if
try
    repeat 2 times
        script u
            property p : 1
        end script
    end repeat
on error
    script v
    end script
end try
--- script object as the last statement
on t(x)
    tell x
        set y to 1
        script s
            property p : y
        end script
    end tell
end t
on u()
    script s
        on f()
            return 1
        end f
    end script
end u
--- script object in a handler with a parent and properties named by words
on t(x)
    script a
    end script
    script b
        property parent : a
        property name : "n"
        property size : 3
        property q : 2
        property class : 5
        on f()
            return {name, size, q, my class}
        end f
    end script
    tell application "Finder"
        script c
            property parent : b
        end script
    end tell
    return {b, c}
end t
--- property named like a variable without a name
on t(a, b, c)
    script s
        property var_1 : 5
        property var_7 : 6
        on g()
            return var_1 + var_7
        end g
    end script
    return s
end t
